moments.text: Infrared view looking down on the sea: a large white cargo ship with deck cranes lies across the middle, purple crosshair above it.
A small white spot emerges from behind the lower-right black box and crosses right to left just below the ship's hull, leaving past the left edge.
The view pans left after it; the ship slides out past the right edge, leaving only sea.
The white spot comes back in from the left edge, dips through the lower left, then swings up to just right of the crosshair.
The spot hovers close to the crosshair over bright, streaky sea, drifting from its upper right round to its left.
The crosshair and all purple symbols vanish; the tiny white spot stays near the centre of the frame until the clip ends.
